title: DevExp SDK prototyping standup - Sep 29 2026
content:
Purpose: quick sync for the week on SDK prototyping, quickstart experiments, and sample repo cleanups. Keep this lean — capture decisions, open questions, and owners.

Attendees: Maya (owner), Zachary (sdk lead), Lena (docs), Omar (samples), Priya (developer advocate — runway experiments).

High-level updates:
- SDK v0.8 prototype: Zach ran a successful end-to-end demo using lightweight streaming helpers; telemetry hooks are wired but sample telemetry events need normalization. Low token overhead observed in local run.
- Quickstart variants: three branches exist: minimal-cli, notebook-tutorial, embed-and-search. Notebook path is the most popular in early testing (15 devs tried it this week).
- Samples repo tidy: Omar started a sweep to remove deprecated examples and add a CONTRIBUTING.md for incoming community PRs.
- Docs draft: Lena posted an initial quickstart narrative that ties to the notebook; still rough on auth flow and rate limits.

What worked:
- Streaming helper prototype reduces dev code by ~30% in example apps (empirical, small n).
- New sample template (compact-config.yml) unifies runtime flags so CI matrix runs faster.

Blockers / Risks:
- Telemetry schema mismatch: analytics backend expects event_name casing snake_case but SDK currently emits camelCase. This causes ingestion drops (ticket JIRA-SDK-342).
- Auth edge case in private deployments: notebook quickstart assumes default API URL and doesn't surface VPC/private endpoints clearly. Could lead to a poor first-run experience for private customers.
- CI flakiness for the embed-and-search sample: flaky on GPU-backed test nodes — need root-cause (infra or sample code?).

Open experiments (hypotheses and metrics):
1) Hypothesis: a guided notebook with inline checks reduces time-to-first-success from 25min to <10min for new users. Metric: completion rate within first run, measured by the sample's `/completed` marker. Current baseline ~40%.
2) Hypothesis: compact-config.yml reduces CI runtime by 20% across sample matrix. Metric: average CI job time.
3) Hypothesis: switching telemetry to snake_case will cut dropped events by 95%. Metric: event drop rate.

Decisions made this standup:
- Pivot notebook quickstart to show private endpoint pattern early (first code cell). Owner: Lena + Omar. Due: Oct 4.
- Standardize telemetry to snake_case in SDK v0.8 branch. Owner: Zach. Due: Oct 1.
- Skip heavy GPU-run tests in main CI; move them to a nightly job while infra investigates flakiness. Owner: Priya + infra SRE (ticket: JIRA-SDK-349).

Action items (owners + due):
- Zach: PR to convert telemetry naming + add event mapping shim for backwards compat. PR target: #487. Due: 2026-10-01.
- Lena: Update notebook quickstart narrative + add explicit private endpoint snippet (with note about KMS/HSM). Also add a short troubleshooting section. Due: 2026-10-04.
- Omar: Complete samples repo sweep; add CONTRIBUTING.md and move deprecated examples to /archive. Notify community channels. Due: 2026-10-06.
- Priya: Create nightly CI config for GPU tests and add a short runbook for interpreting flaky failures. Coordinate with infra. Due: 2026-10-05.

Notes-to-self / brainstorming fragments (rough):
- Could we show a small visual in the notebook that confirms KV cache warming? Quick gif? (low priority)
- Consider a one-click sandbox (hosted ephemeral token) for the notebook path — product/solutions alignment required.
- If telemetry renaming causes regressions for older customers, add opt-in toggle in client config.

Questions for leadership / cross-team asks:
- Request for infra: can SRE allocate 4 hours to triage the GPU CI flakiness next week? Tagging infra on JIRA.
- Product ask: are we ok shipping notebook quickstart with a note that explicit Private deployment examples are "beta" (docs + risk callout)?

Parking lot / items for next standup:
- User onboarding funnel: add a short metric snapshot once we have notebook completion telemetry (Priya).
- Quickstart video walkthrough (short screencast) — estimate: 1.5 days of effort.
- Decide on community contribution checklist for sample PRs (code style, runtime policy, license).

Quick links (working):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/487
- Samples repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples (working branch: refactor/compact-config)
- JIRA: JIRA-SDK-342, JIRA-SDK-349, JIRA-DOCS-174

End-of-note: keep this doc as a working log — if you copy fragments to Confluence, please add a link back.

-- Maya
